LESSON: WRITING 13.5.1 CREATIVE NARRATIVE COMPOSITION: IDIOMS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.5: Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms, part of Strand 13 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What makes a story outstanding? 2. How can we improve our writing skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search online and offline for the meaning of the following idioms: - have the guts - burn the midnight oil - apple of one’s eye - come in handy - time is ripe - hit the nail on the head - cry over spilt milk

2. engage in a language game such as use of task cards, on sentence construction featuring the given idioms such,

3. write a narrative composition using the specified idioms,

4. share the compositions in groups for peer review. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search online and offline for the meaning of the following idioms: - have the guts - burn the midnight oil - apple of one’s eye - come in handy - time is ripe - hit the nail on the head - cry over spilt milk
2. engage in a language game such as use of task cards, on sentence construction featuring the given idioms such,
3. write a narrative composition using the specified idioms,
4. share the compositions in groups for peer review. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 13.5.1 Creative Narrative Composition: Idioms together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner reflects on progress made as they share their compositions.

• Digital literacy: It is achieved as learner interacts with technology when confirming online the meaning of the specified

idioms.

Values:
Respect: It is fostered as the learner listens to peers ́ opinions and views about their compositions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):
